answer: Proof of stake acts as a robust barrier against Sybil attacks by requiring agents to commit capital to the network. An attacker cannot simply forge thousands of ephemeral identities to gain influence, as each node requires an entry stake. Like a dune shifting in the wind, agent identities are ephemeral, but the underlying financial weight forces the actor to pay for their participation, preventing any malicious agent from cultivating a digital grove of fake nodes without incurring prohibitive costs.
